comparisons.interpretation: Both explicitly list healthcare as their first issue. Ocasio-Cortez names expanded Medicare for All; Crowley's short priority item does not specify an insurance mechanism.
Ocasio-Cortez explicitly calls for ICE abolition, while Crowley promises comprehensive immigration reform. The latter's unspecified agency policy is not coded as opposition to abolition.

Ocasio-Cortez criticizes Democrats settling for inadequate outcomes and emphasizes political courage; Crowley promises congressional action for working families. This compares their stated framing without inferring unspoken policy disagreement.
